why: This topic asked one question of four trials that answer three different ones. It was SPLIT rather than narrowed: choosing a single reading would have discarded the other questions without saying so. It is retired, not deleted -- the entire former object is preserved below and every trial it held is either carried into a successor or adjudicated out with a named reason.
a_tombstone_is_not_an_absence: A later auditor must be able to SEE that a split happened rather than infer it from a gap. Deleting this file would make the corpus tidier and the history unreadable.

NCT00168805.why: CARRIED FROM THE PREDECESSOR, not surfaced. RE-MODEL is coded with the broader term `Thromboembolism` while the query asked for VENOUS thromboembolism, so the search did not return it. It is an arthroplasty prophylaxis trial and belongs in SURGICAL. Carried explicitly so the split does not drop a trial the predecessor held.

NCT01505881.why: ADJUDICATED OUT, with the reason named. This is the RE-ALIGN follow-on in a MECHANICAL HEART VALVE population -- conditions `Thromboembolism, Heart Valve Prosthesis` -- whose registered primary is `Percentage of Patients With Any Adverse Event`. It is not a venous thromboembolism trial and not a member of any of the four readings. It is NOT DELETED: the whole trial record is preserved on the tombstone and this reason travels with it.

primary.outcome_definition: Percentage of Participants With Composite of Venous Thrombotic Event (VTE) or Major Bleeding Event (MBE) According to International Society on Thrombosis and Haemostasis (ISTH) Criteria in Full Observation Period.

outcome_definition_source.time_frame: From first administration of trial medication until 6 days after last administration of trial medication, up to 25 weeks.
outcome_definition_source.description_verbatim:
Composite of the percentage of participants with MBE according to ISTH criteria and VTE (recurring cerebral venous thrombosis (CVT); deep venous thrombosis (DVT) of any limb, pulmonary embolism (PE), splanchnic vein thrombosis) in full observation period. All components were adjudicated in a blinded manner.

Major bleeds were defined according to the ISTH definition of a major bleed, as follows:

* Symptomatic bleeding in a critical area or organ, such as intracranial, intraspinal, intraocular, retroperitoneal, intra-articular or pericardial, or intramuscular with compartment syndrome and/or
* Bleeding associated with a reduction in haemoglobin of at least 2 grams/deciLitre (1.24 millimole/Litre) within 24 h, or leading to transfusion of 2 or more units of blood or packed cells and/or
* Fatal bleed
outcome_definition_source.components_as_the_registry_states_them: a composite of VENOUS THROMBOTIC EVENT **or** MAJOR BLEEDING -- efficacy and safety combined INSIDE one endpoint, which is a third distinct quantity again.

Total Venous Thromboembolic Event (VTE) includes both proximal and distal deep vein thrombosis (DVT) (detected by routine bilateral venography), symptomatic DVT (confirmed by venous compression ultrasound, venography or autopsy) and pulmonary embolism (PE) (confirmed by pulmonary V-Q scintigraphy, chest x-ray, pulmonary angiography, spiral CT or autopsy).

primary.poolable_reason: FOUR TRIALS, FOUR DIFFERENT REGISTERED PRIMARIES, AND THEY ARE NOT EVEN THE SAME KIND OF QUANTITY. Verbatim: RE-MEDY registers 'Composite of Recurrent VTE or VTE Death'; NCT01505881 registers 'Percentage of Patients With Any Adverse Event (AE)'; NCT02913326 registers a 'Composite of Venous Thrombotic Event (VTE) or Major Bleeding Event (MBE)'; NCT00168805 registers 'Total Venous Thromboembolic Event and All-cause Mortality'. ONE IS AN EFFICACY COMPOSITE, ONE IS A PURE SAFETY TALLY, ONE COMBINES EFFICACY AND SAFETY INSIDE A SINGLE ENDPOINT, AND ONE ADDS ALL-CAUSE DEATH TO A THROMBOTIC OUTCOME. Averaging them produces a number none of the four measured. AND ONE STORED COUNT IS IMPOSSIBLE ON ITS FACE: RE-MEDY's treatment arm is recorded as 1,404 events in 1,430 participants -- 98 per cent. Recurrent venous thromboembolism did not occur in 98 per cent of a dabigatran arm. That figure cannot be the registered primary's event count and is most likely its complement, which would invert the trial's contribution entirely.

pooled.withdrawn_reason: FOUR TRIALS, FOUR DIFFERENT REGISTERED PRIMARIES, AND THEY ARE NOT EVEN THE SAME KIND OF QUANTITY. Verbatim: RE-MEDY registers 'Composite of Recurrent VTE or VTE Death'; NCT01505881 registers 'Percentage of Patients With Any Adverse Event (AE)'; NCT02913326 registers a 'Composite of Venous Thrombotic Event (VTE) or Major Bleeding Event (MBE)'; NCT00168805 registers 'Total Venous Thromboembolic Event and All-cause Mortality'. ONE IS AN EFFICACY COMPOSITE, ONE IS A PURE SAFETY TALLY, ONE COMBINES EFFICACY AND SAFETY INSIDE A SINGLE ENDPOINT, AND ONE ADDS ALL-CAUSE DEATH TO A THROMBOTIC OUTCOME. Averaging them produces a number none of the four measured. AND ONE STORED COUNT IS IMPOSSIBLE ON ITS FACE: RE-MEDY's treatment arm is recorded as 1,404 events in 1,430 participants -- 98 per cent. Recurrent venous thromboembolism did not occur in 98 per cent of a dabigatran arm. That figure cannot be the registered primary's event count and is most likely its complement, which would invert the trial's contribution entirely.
pooled.withdrawn_note: WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: NOT that dabigatran fails to prevent recurrent venous thromboembolism. The trials here measure recurrence in one trial, adverse events in another, and a mixture in a third, and nothing on this page estimates the question its title implies. WHAT IS CONFIRMED: the original withdrawal was RIGHT, and its stated reason -- 'adverse-event and efficacy endpoints pooled' -- is exactly what NCT01505881's registration says. Re-verification added the impossible 98-per-cent count and the third and fourth endpoint types the original reason did not name. THE REPLACEMENT QUESTION IS PARKED: RE-MEDY and NCT00168805 are closest to a shared thrombotic estimand, but one adds all-cause death and the other does not, and RE-MEDY's counts must be resolved from source first.
pooled.reverification: RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-18. VERDICT: CONFIRMED and SHARPENED. The stated reason survives and understates the problem: not two endpoint types but four, plus a stored count of 1,404 in 1,430 that cannot be a recurrent-VTE event total.
pooled.card_note: CONFIRMED and sharpened: FOUR different registered primaries -- an efficacy composite, a pure ANY-ADVERSE-EVENT tally, a VTE-or-major-bleeding composite, and VTE with all-cause death. RE-MEDY's stored count of 1,404 in 1,430 (98%) cannot be a recurrent-VTE total

primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.
